model_brand_notes: Added 2026-09-14 after a review found that every make shown on a homepage machine tile was an inference with nothing behind it. brands and models are two independent flat lists with no mapping, so this object is the mapping.

The project constitution says machine model tokens become fitment tags only after ACBG confirms the parsing rule. status is 'unconfirmed' for every entry until ACBG signs the mapping off, at which point status becomes 'confirmed' and source records who confirmed it.

Render rule: show a make chip only for a model present here. A model with brand null renders 'To confirm'. While any entry is unconfirmed the machine section carries the line 'Makes are our reading of the model code and are being confirmed with each manufacturer's published range.'
